description: This file contains unit tests for the FrameType class template, testing buffer manipulation, copy, and access methods, using the Google Test framework.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A template class representing a buffer frame with methods for setting and getting data, copying, and size management.

classes.name: FrameType<BLOCKSIZE>.Writer
classes.description: A helper nested class for writing data into a FrameType buffer.

classes.name: FrameType<BLOCKSIZE>.Reader
classes.description: A helper nested class for reading data from a FrameType buffer.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets data in the buffer at a specified offset with a given length.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves data from the buffer at a specified offset with a given length.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets or gets the buffer size.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the buffer to an initial state.
